what_became_physically_true: HCLI TALKED TO ITS RESIDENT, END TO END, NINE TIMES. tools/hcli_resident/serve_sealed.py puts /v1/chat/completions over the sealed 3.1393 binary, and a real bounded Accelerator mission ran plan -> execute -> verify -> synthesize -> envelope against it (receipts/headless/HCLI_RESIDENT_END_TO_END.json, G083). The blocker was never architectural: HCLI speaks OpenAI, the resident is a Rust greedy example, and `hawking gravity serve` wants model-*.gravity shards that do not exist because every body on disk is .hq30uq4 / .f32v2 / .hgrafv01.

THE SERVER REFUSES TO START UNLESS DISK MATCHES THE SEAL -- runtime binary sha256 byte for byte, tokenizer and chat-template hashes, the 628-dispatch graph, the pre_closed_think arm, the four fusion levers -- and every mismatch is reported rather than the first. --allow-unsealed stamps sealed:false on EVERY RESPONSE so a divergence travels with the output instead of being lost at startup (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_SEALED_RESIDENT_ENDPOINT.json).

A SAMPLER REQUEST IS REFUSED RATHER THAN IGNORED, because the sealed path is greedy argmax and honouring temperature silently is how a benchmark measures a different sampler than it asked for. The arm is refused the same way: enable_thinking=true asks for open_think, and the same bytes score 30/43 and 35/43 on the two arms (tools/hcli_resident/serve_sealed.py).

BENCH_STATE IS NOW A SCHEMA REQUIREMENT. tools/accelerator/receipt.py refuses a receipt whose result tree quotes a duration, a rate or a speed ratio and passes no bench block, and the scan walks the WHOLE tree rather than the top level (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_BENCH_STATE_IS_A_SCHEMA_REQUIREMENT.json, G078).

QUIESCED HAS TO BE EARNED. bench_block takes NO state argument, so the state is derived from samples and a caller cannot stamp QUIESCED on a contended measurement without editing the derivation; QUIESCED with no sample, or with contenders recorded, is refused; and a `ps` that exited non-zero derives UNKNOWN, because it found nothing only because it could not look (tools/accelerator/bench.py).

LATENCY IS FIRST CLASS AND ITS TAIL CARRIES ITS RESOLUTION. tools/accelerator/bench.py::time_arm now reports p50/p95/p99 and p95_over_p50, and says so when fewer than five samples stand behind p95 -- at the default 40 reps only three do, which makes it an order statistic and not a percentile estimate (S032 §16).

AN AMENDMENT MUST DECLARE WHAT IT REACHES. tools/accelerator/akb.py marks a law CONDITIONAL when its source receipt is amended, and an amendment may now exempt a law only BY LAW_ID -- explicit registration, never an inference about scope from a filename (S032 §13).

THE SHELL GUARD'S BOTH SIDES FIRED IN PRODUCTION (G076): a python3 check naming a protected path was refused with exit 126, and the same command ran to completion once the mission stopped protecting the directory its own question was about.
what_was_refuted: REFUTED, AND IT AGREED WITH PRODUCTION TO 0.9% WHILE BEING WRONG: the settling arm for the MLP fusion mechanism printed 17.2 us per removed dispatch against production's independently measured 17.35 us/dispatch for the gate_up pair. two_dispatch() returned `a + b`, which MLX evaluates as its own kernel, so the arm ran THREE dispatches while being reported as two. Corrected over two removed dispatches it is 8.6 us -- HALF the production figure -- so the synthetic arm does NOT reproduce it (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_MLP_OPERAND_REUSE_REFUTED.json, G079). An agreement is the weakest moment to check arithmetic and the moment it matters most.

REFUTED: that a receipt with no machine state is neutral. 297 receipts quote a duration and ONE carried any machine state; an absent state reads as a clean measurement to every downstream reader, including the AKB and a later session. The silence made a claim the receipts never made (receipts/headless/ACCELERATOR_BENCH_STATE_IS_A_SCHEMA_REQUIREMENT.json).

REFUTED: that a one-time backfill can hold. A launchd job regenerates receipts every five minutes without a bench block, and eighteen had already lost their stamp forty minutes after the first pass. The backfill is now an idempotent tool with a --check mode and the corpus test names the command (tools/accelerator/stamp_bench_state.py).

REFUTED: that the planner failure was a shape failure. `$: missing required property 'obligations'` was reported on a reply whose top level WAS obligations -- the model emitted an unescaped quote, the outer object failed to decode, and extract_json_object silently salvaged the SECOND OBLIGATION as if it were the root. Six retries chased a phantom (hcli/backends.py, G083).

REFUTED: that the model was ignoring the admissibility rule. _COMMAND_FIRST is enforced in verify() and appeared in NO PROMPT. After disclosing it -- built from the allowlist itself so it cannot drift -- the resident proposed a python3 assert instead of `grep | wc -l` (hcli/verifier_pipeline.py).

A third mutation showed a rename type-guard changed no outcome, and it was DELETED rather than left looking like a safeguard (hcli/test_near_miss_key.py).
